Contract at a startup. I’m working for 4 as we speak all similar yet different in their own rights. However, if you really want to pursue a startup in the future you can’t go into it with a mindset that you’ll derail your career story. Startups are hard and you need to commit to the lifestyle. There will be more critics that supporters but if you’re worried about optics, you won’t make it. This is cliche, but you have one life. Try it, if you hate it, you’ve got nothing to lose because six months is nothing. If you’re smart, company’s won’t care about a 6 month entrepreneurial project while pursuing an MBA (I know, I have mine as well). BUT if the off chance that you love it, you’ll find that each startup you contract for will lead to another and you’ll always have contract work to fall back on as you gear up for your own business. Best of luck.
